title: E0072: Path traversal
plain_english: Using user-controlled input to build a file path without sanitizing `../` sequences can allow an attacker to read or write files outside the intended directory.
why_matters: Path traversal vulnerabilities can allow attackers to: - Read sensitive files such as `/etc/passwd`, source code, or credentials - Write arbitrary files to the server - Achieve remote code execution when combined with other vulnerabilities, such as file upload
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `file_get_contents()`, `file_put_contents()`, and `fopen()` with paths built from tainted input
`../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences in user-controlled paths
